article_title: Apple warns of future 'supply constraints' for Mac, iPhone, iPad

tasks.prompt: What tension is at the centre of the article?
options: Apple has stopped making computers because demand disappeared
Apple plans to replace all iPhones with iPads
Apple reported strong demand but warned that component shortages could limit future sales
Apple's services business has been sold to another company
tasks.correct_answer: Apple reported strong demand but warned that component shortages could limit future sales
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מדגישה ניגוד בין ביקוש ותוצאות חזקות לבין החשש שמחסור ברכיבים יגביל את היכולת לספק מוצרים בהמשך.

tasks.prompt: Which products did Apple say could face greater supply constraints?
options: Only Apple Watch straps
Mac, iPhone and iPad
Only older iPod models
Apple TV films and music subscriptions
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האזהרה בכותרת ובכתבה מתייחסת במפורש למחשבי Mac, למכשירי iPhone ולמכשירי iPad.

tasks.prompt: What wider technology trend is contributing to pressure on memory and storage chip supplies?
options: The closure of all online shops
A global fall in the use of smartphones
New rules banning memory chips in computers
Large AI data-centre build-outs consuming more chips
tasks.correct_answer: Large AI data-centre build-outs consuming more chips
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הרחבת מרכזי הנתונים לצורכי בינה מלאכותית מגדילה מאוד את הביקוש לשבבי זיכרון ואחסון ויוצרת לחץ על ההיצע.

tasks.prompt: What does “supply constraints” mean in this article?
options: Limits on Apple's ability to obtain components and make enough products
A marketing plan to reduce customer interest
A promise to lower every product price
A legal ban on selling devices abroad
tasks.correct_answer: Limits on Apple's ability to obtain components and make enough products
tasks.explanation_hebrew: supply constraints הן מגבלות היצע: קושי להשיג מספיק רכיבים או לייצר מספיק מוצרים ביחס לביקוש.

tasks.prompt: If Apple “stockpiles inventory”, what is the company doing?
options: Destroying devices that have not been sold
Borrowing phones from customers
Building up a reserve of products or components for later use
Removing all goods from its warehouses
tasks.correct_answer: Building up a reserve of products or components for later use
tasks.explanation_hebrew: to stockpile inventory פירושו לצבור מלאי מראש כדי שיהיה אפשר להתמודד עם מחסור עתידי.

tasks.prompt: The article discusses Apple's “outlook”. What does “outlook” mean in a business report?
options: The physical appearance of a new device
The company's expectations for future performance
A list of former employees
A review of its earliest products
tasks.correct_answer: The company's expectations for future performance
tasks.explanation_hebrew: outlook בהקשר עסקי הוא תחזית או ציפיות החברה לגבי מכירות, הכנסות ותנאים עסקיים בתקופה הקרובה.

tasks.prompt: Why can strong customer demand create a problem when component supplies are tight? Answer in 2–3 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהביקוש אינו הופך אוטומטית למכירות אם החברה אינה יכולה לייצר ולספק מספיק יחידות בגלל מחסור ברכיבים.
expected_points: Strong demand means more customers want products
Limited components restrict how many devices Apple can produce
Unmet demand can reduce or delay sales despite customer interest

tasks.prompt: Write an 80–110 word summary of Apple's results, its warning, and the market reaction.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את הביקוש החזק, המחסור הצפוי בשבבי זיכרון ואחסון, ההשלכה על מוצרי החברה והתגובה השלילית של המשקיעים.
expected_points: Apple reported strong demand or recent business performance
The company warned that supply constraints may grow
Memory and storage chips are under pressure partly because of AI data-centre demand
Investors focused on the weaker outlook and Apple shares fell

tasks.prompt: Explain in 3–4 sentences why Apple's shares could fall even after strong recent results.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להבחין בין תוצאות העבר לבין ציפיות לעתיד ולהסביר שמשקיעים מתמחרים את ההשפעה האפשרית של מגבלות היצע ועלויות רכיבים.
expected_points: Share prices also reflect expectations about future sales and profits
Supply constraints may prevent Apple from meeting demand
Higher component costs or weaker guidance can worry investors

tasks.prompt: Use the terms “constraint”, “inventory”, and “outlook” in a short paragraph explaining Apple's response to the chip shortage.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש בשלושת המונחים במשמעות העסקית הנכונה ולחבר ביניהם באופן שמתאים למצב המתואר בכתבה.
expected_points: Constraint is used for a limit on component supply
Inventory is used for products or components held in reserve
Outlook is used for future business expectations
The paragraph explains how inventory may soften but not eliminate the constraint
